description: Built the Kapil Dabi podcast prep Word doc with a 'Suggestion for Flow' / guest-angle section, treating Episode 11's Topics and Questions doc as the representative template for Janine's format.
correction: David corrected that Janine's docs do not typically include a suggested-flow section. Re-reviewed Episodes 1-4 (and spot-checked others) in SharePoint — none contain a flow/angle section; only Episode 11 has one, making it an outlier rather than the pattern. Rebuilt the doc as a plain numbered questions list matching the typical format.
systemic_fix: When matching a recurring document format, sample multiple past instances (not just the most recent one) before generalizing the template.
